To assess this capability, we developed DynBench100, a benchmark of 100 simulated single-cell time-course scenarios with hidden dynamical ground truth. CellCompass achieved the highest aggregate performance among the tested general-purpose and biomedical agents across six dynamical tasks. Across four real single-cell studies, it retained an existing velocity-growth model to reconstruct context-dependent epithelial-mesenchymal transition and developed three new dynamical formulations for distinct experimental measurements. In drug-response data, incorporating metabolic RNA labeling reduced pulse-control identifiability error by 31.1%, revealing staged response programs and generating testable predictions for perturbing a candidate adaptive program. In hematopoietic lineage tracing, incorporating clonal barcodes improved clone-fate agreement by 54% over the strongest dynamical baseline, identifying early lineage priming among transcriptionally similar progenitors. Finally, in time-resolved CITE-seq data, CellCompass reduced future surface-protein distribution error by 13.2% for RNA-initialized trajectories, uncovering lineage-specific temporal offsets between transcriptional and protein programs. Together, CellCompass provides a framework in which virtual-cell dynamics can expand with the biological measurements used to constrain them.

summary.takeaway: 提出 CellCompass，将科学智能体与可扩展动力学引擎结合，使虚拟细胞模型能随新实验测量设计、实现并修正动力学方程；在 DynBench100 及四项真实单细胞研究中表现优于对比的通用与生物医学智能体。
summary.methods: 构建 agentic AI 系统，复用现有动力学表述或在测量引入新约束时设计新表述；提出含 100 个模拟单细胞时间序列场景、具隐藏动力学真值的 DynBench100 基准；在 EMT、药物响应、造血谱系示踪和 CITE-seq 等真实数据上评估。
summary.relevance: 直接对应虚拟细胞主题，关注如何从单细胞测量构建可预测细胞状态随时间变化的动力学模型。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出基准与真实数据的完整统计检验细节；所报告的性能提升主要来自特定任务和数据集，泛化性尚待更多独立验证。

papers.title: Rebuilding a Field's Open-Problem Catalog from the Literature: A Two-Layer Knowledge Graph, and Why Status Must Stay Proposed
papers.abstract: A research field records its open problems in surveys, keynotes and community reports. Those are prose, written every few years, and nobody can ask them who works on a problem now or whether it was settled last year. We argue the problems should be data, and we build the system that makes them so: a hand-curated problem layer carried in unchanged, under an evidence layer rebuilt from a bibliographic index, joined by typed, provenance-carrying links in one graph database and queryable from one language. A language model does four jobs -- per-paper extraction, catalog grounding, per-paper status verdict, and idea generation -- each constrained to a candidate set so out-of-set answers are refused rather than stored. We report a study on two curated catalogs, database research (1,053 problems) and AI research (1,000 problems), each with a prior catalog-only graph. The rebuilt graph answers every question the catalog-only graph answered -- 47 of 47 on databases, 34 of 35 on AI -- plus questions the catalog-only graph refused: recent workers, untouched problems, methods tried, and outside papers bearing on a problem (336 problems, 770 works on databases). The capability we most wanted does not survive its own audit. Of 41 solves and refutes verdicts hand-checked against the papers, 9 are correct, 30 partly correct and 2 wrong; no refutes verdict (0 of 34) disproves an open problem, and only 1 of 7 solves closes the central question. We report that failure in full and draw the design conclusion: a status change must be proposed with its evidence and never applied, making the human reviewer part of the architecture. We close with the data-engineering problems this raises: entity resolution across curated and harvested layers, verifying model status claims, freshness under source quotas, and evaluation without ground truth.

summary.takeaway: 将研究领域的开放问题整理为可查询数据，构建手 curated 问题层与文献证据层组成的双层知识图谱，并报告了 LLM 判定问题状态的审计失败，主张状态变更只能提出、不能自动应用。
summary.methods: 以图数据库和统一查询语言连接问题层与从文献索引重建的证据层；用 LLM 完成逐论文抽取、目录接地、逐论文状态判定和想法生成，并限制在候选集内；在两个目录上开展研究并人工核验 41 条 solves/refutes 判定。
summary.relevance: 属于知识图谱与机制推理方向，涉及从文献构建可追溯知识结构及 LLM 证据判定。
summary.caveat: 作者明确报告状态判定可靠性不足：41 条判定中 9 条正确、30 条部分正确、2 条错误，refutes 判定均未推翻开放问题；结论强调需人工复核，自动状态更新不可信。

papers.title: Routed Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Agents deployed at scale repeatedly encounter related problems, and it is natural to let them learn from each other's experience rather than starting over each time. Unfortunately, there is no single way to retain that experience that works well across settings, and no way to know in advance which future problems a given experience will help with. A global history preserves every detail but becomes expensive and mixes together experience that may not belong together; compressing that history into one fixed representation limits the cost but can throw away valuable details. We introduce Routed Continual Learning (Routed CL), an architecture that decides how to partition and retain experience. Past trajectories are grouped into clusters, each of which maintains state using one memory system from a fixed library. Before each run, an LLM-based router either reuses an existing cluster or creates a new one, basing its decision on the problem statement, memory system descriptions, and cluster summaries. We also introduce Context Memory Adapter, which mediates between the memory system and the agentic loop. We evaluate the architecture on a heterogeneous stream that interleaves 301 instances from the six CL-Bench tasks with 97 banking instances from $τ^3$-Bench. Across four language models and five matched rollouts, Routed Continual Learning raises normalized reward over a single global in-context learning (ICL) history by 15-30% of the maximum attainable normalized reward, achieves higher mean normalized reward than ICL-only clustering, and reduces estimated API cost by 65-72% relative to Global ICL. These results support approaching continual learning as a routing problem that chooses both a learning mechanism and a state cluster rather than committing to one representation globally.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Routed Continual Learning，将持续学习视为路由问题，对经验进行聚类并为每类选择合适记忆系统，从而在异构任务流上兼顾性能与成本。
summary.methods: 将过去轨迹聚类，每个簇使用固定记忆库中的一种记忆系统；由 LLM 路由器根据问题陈述、记忆系统描述和簇摘要决定复用或新建簇；引入 Context Memory Adapter 连接记忆系统与智能体循环；在 CL-Bench 六任务 301 实例与 τ³-Bench 97 个银行实例的混合流上，用四个语言模型和五次匹配 rollout 评测。
summary.relevance: 对应持续学习主题，研究智能体如何保留和复用跨任务经验。
summary.caveat: 评测集中于特定基准组合与有限模型；路由与聚类决策依赖 LLM，摘要未充分说明路由错误或分布漂移下的稳健性。

papers.title: FIRME: Registry-Anchored Memory Graphs for Evolving, Heterogeneous Investor Knowledge
papers.abstract: Financial AI workflows that reuse investor knowledge need persistent memory that integrates observations across sources and periods without losing identity or provenance. In a knowledge graph, recurring observations may use different surface forms, fragmenting relationship histories and preventing evidence from accumulating. We introduce Fusion and Identity Registry for Memory Evolution (FIRME), a registry-anchored memory graph that reconciles incoming observations to persistent canonical relationships and retains their source, time, and context. Within periods, rule-based fusion links investor-call discussions to portfolio cash-flow signals, directly or through a fixed product-topic ontology. Across periods, canonical identities and persistent aliases direct recurring observations to the same relationship history; deterministic updates summarize reinforcement, inactivity, and reactivation. We evaluate FIRME on proprietary investor-call and cash-flow records and on S&P 500 earnings-call transcripts. Compared with a historical registry that retains canonical identities and semantic fallback but omits alias memory, FIRME increases final-period Correct Match Rate by 7.8-12.1 percentage points across four dataset-backend settings under a fixed-judge and fallback-review protocol. A blinded human audit of 200 incoming observations per setting finds Correct Match Rate gains of 9.0-16.5 points and reattachment-recall gains of 22.5-29.0 points, with higher observed merge precision in all four samples. A separate audit finds valid evidence paths for 293 of 300 outputs from full within-period fusion in the investor-call setting. Extraction-faithfulness and round-trip diagnostics assess source grounding and preservation of extractor-derived graph content.

summary.takeaway: 提出 FIRME，一种以注册表为锚的记忆图，将不同来源和时期的投资者观察归并到持久规范关系上并保留来源、时间和上下文，提升匹配与重新挂接召回。
summary.methods: 期内用规则融合将投资者电话讨论与组合现金流信号直接或经固定产品主题本体连接；跨期用规范身份和持久别名指向同一关系历史，并以确定性更新总结强化、失活和重新激活；在专有投资者电话与现金流记录及 S&P 500 财报电话记录上评估，并做盲法人工审计。
summary.relevance: 涉及知识图谱与检索增强中的实体消解、来源追踪和记忆演化，服务于金融知识复用。
summary.caveat: 依赖专有数据与固定本体；评估使用固定评判与回退复核协议，摘要未说明跨领域迁移和抽取错误对图谱的长期影响。

papers.title: Lysosomal biophysics in CLN3 disease: Connecting membrane transport, molecular homeostasis, and tissue dysfunction.
papers.abstract: CLN3 disease (CLN3 Batten disease) is a lysosomal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by early retinal degeneration and progressive neurological dysfunction, yet the mechanisms connecting CLN3-dependent membrane physiology to selective cellular and tissue vulnerability remain unresolved. This review integrates current evidence across four experimentally separable scales: membrane biophysics, molecular and organellar homeostasis, cell-specific function, and tissue pathology. Direct electrophysiological studies support a luminal pH-sensitive CLN3-dependent lysosomal chloride conductance associated, in tested systems, with changes in luminal chloride, pH, cathepsin activity, and protein degradation. Independently, CLN3 deficiency disrupts glycerophosphodiester clearance, phospholipid and cholesterol handling, cation-independent mannose 6-phosphate receptor trafficking, hydrolase delivery, and autophagic lysosomal reformation. These organellar abnormalities coexist with distinct phenotypes in retinal pigment epithelium, neurons, microglia, astrocytes, and brain endothelial cells, together with retinal, neural-circuit, and myelin abnormalities at the tissue level. Current evidence does not establish a universal chloride-first or storage-first cascade; instead, it supports interacting CLN3-dependent modules whose causal ordering may vary by cell type, model, and disease stage. We therefore propose a multiscale mechanistic framework that links measurable lysosomal physical variables to molecular homeostasis, cell-specific function, and tissue vulnerability while preserving the distinction between direct evidence and mechanistic inference. This framework defines testable priorities for causal ordering, rescue experiments, and mechanism-matched target engagement in CLN3 disease.
papers.venue: Progress in biophysics and molecular biology

summary.takeaway: 综述 CLN3 病中溶酶体膜生物物理、分子稳态、细胞类型功能与组织病理四个尺度的证据，提出相互作用的 CLN3 依赖模块框架，而非单一氯离子优先或储存优先级联。
summary.methods: 整合电生理、溶酶体氯电导、脂质与转运、自噬溶酶体再形成及多种细胞和组织表型证据，区分直接证据与机制推断，并提出可检验的因果排序和救援实验优先项。
summary.relevance: 对应机制推理，展示如何跨尺度整合证据并构建可检验的机制框架。
summary.caveat: 为综述性文章，未提供新的原始实验数据；作者明确指出当前证据尚不能确定统一因果顺序，框架中的因果推断仍需实验验证。

papers.title: Can LLMs Faithfully Solve Ontology Engineering Tasks? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study
papers.abstract: Ontological knowledge underpins large language model (LLM) performance on knowledge-intensive tasks. However, existing evaluations of LLMs' ontological understanding largely rely on behavioral correctness, leaving the underlying mechanisms unexplained. Existing mechanistic interpretability work has largely focused on instance-level factual knowledge, leaving ontological knowledge under-explored. To bridge this gap, we introduce MIOE, a causal-abstraction benchmark that evaluates interchange interventions for two ontology engineering tasks: entity typing and subsumption prediction. MIOE tests whether learned internal intervention targets can change an ontology-level target answer while preserving class-specific auxiliary information. Across Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B, we evaluate SAE-, DBM-, and DAS-based methods, including multi-task and multi-layer variants. Distributed subspace methods give the strongest results and generalize across prompt settings, but the induced changes remain only partially separated from auxiliary class-specific information. Multi-task objectives and contiguous layer-window interventions improve this balance, while class-level analyses reveal substantial variation across ontology classes. These results suggest that ontological predictions are mechanistically accessible in LLMs, although current methods do not yet isolate a cleanly disentangled causal mechanism for ontological knowledge.

summary.takeaway: 提出 MIOE 因果抽象基准，检验 LLM 本体工程任务中的内部干预能否改变本体级答案并保留类别辅助信息，发现分布式子空间方法最强但尚未实现清晰解耦的因果机制。
summary.methods: 针对实体类型和包含预测两项任务，在 Qwen3-8B 与 Qwen3-4B 上评估 SAE、DBM 和 DAS 类方法及多任务、多层变体，采用交换干预和类别级分析。
summary.relevance: 属于大语言模型机制可解释性与机制推理，探讨本体知识在模型内部的可及性。

papers.title: Stress-response regulators tune enterobacterial common antigen synthesis to support acid and reactive nitrogen species stress resistance
papers.abstract: Enteric bacteria must survive envelope-damaging environmental conditions in both host and environmental niches (e.g., acidic environments, reactive oxygen and nitrogen species). The Gram-negative outer membrane (OM) is central to the cells stress resistance, acting as a permeability barrier to antimicrobials and as an adaptable structure remodeled in response to environmental changes. Enterobacterales (e.g., Escherichia coli, Salmonella enterica, Klebsiella pneumoniae) produce an invariant glycan, enterobacterial common antigen (ECA), which is localized in the OM and periplasm and contributes to the OM permeability barrier. Yet, how ECA biosynthesis is controlled and the conditions under which ECA is important remain poorly defined. Therefore, we investigated transcriptional regulation of the ECA biosynthesis wec operon in E. coli K-12. We assayed wec operon promoter activity across deletions of 36 bioinformatically identified potential regulator genes and identified four for which deletion significantly altered wec promoter activity. Of these, two repressors, GadX, a regulator of the glutamate-dependent acid stress response system, and MetJ, the master regulator of methionine biosynthesis and a reactive nitrogen species (RNS) stress regulator, bound to the wec promoter in vitro, consistent with direct transcriptional regulation. In accordance with a link between ECA and these regulators, wec promoter activity increased under acidic pH and under RNS stress, and loss of ECA impaired growth under both conditions and fitness in acidic pH. Together, these findings reveal that biosynthesis of a conserved OM glycan is embedded within dedicated environmental stress regulons and identify previously unrecognized roles for ECA in bacterial stress adaptation.

summary.takeaway: 发现大肠杆菌 ECA 合成 wec 操纵子受酸应激调节子 GadX 和 RNS 调节子 MetJ 直接抑制，且酸性 pH 和 RNS 应激下 wec 启动子活性升高，ECA 缺失损害相应条件下的生长与酸性 pH 适应度。
summary.methods: 在大肠杆菌 K-12 中检测 36 个候选调节基因缺失对 wec 启动子活性的影响，结合体外结合实验、酸性 pH 与 RNS 应激下的启动子活性及生长/适应度测定。
summary.relevance: 对应 GRN/Regulon 主题，揭示保守外膜聚糖合成嵌入环境应激调节网络。
summary.caveat: 研究主要基于 K-12 的转录调控和体外结合证据，摘要未展示其他肠杆菌中的保守性验证或体内直接调控机制细节。

papers.title: Phylogenomics, spatiotemporal transcriptional dynamics and Cis-regulatory architecture underlying the Portulaca oleracea antioxidant network under extreme salinity.
papers.abstract: Global soil salinization severely threatens agricultural productivity. Portulaca oleracea L., an extreme xerohalophyte, displays exceptional salinity tolerance, yet the transcriptional architecture coordinating its antioxidant defenses across organs and developmental stages remains unresolved. In this study, multi-tissue high-throughput RNA-Seq, quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) validation, comparative phylogenomics across 154 plant genomes, and condition-specific gene regulatory network (GRN) modeling were integrated to characterize 436 antioxidant loci in P. oleracea. Under chronic hypersalinity (12 d), mature plants exhibited marked regulatory asymmetry: roots mounted a multi-tiered frontline defense driven by Fe/Mn-SOD (SOD2), cytosolic glutaredoxin 3 (50.24-fold induction), and class III peroxidases (PRX), whereas leaves suppressed multiple baseline peroxidase transcripts while selectively upregulating a putative secretory PRX (110.24-fold induction). Comparing developmental stages and stress durations revealed that juvenile leaves mounted a pronounced activation of glutathione-dependent pathways (GPX/GR) during acute osmotic stress, whereas adult foliage subjected to chronic salinity displayed a streamlined network consistent with catalase (CAT) post-transcriptional stabilization hypotheses and an upregulated glycine, serine, and threonine metabolic axis. GRN modeling predicted seven stress-specific candidate hub transcription factors (spanning the B3, LBD, C3H, AP2/ERF, and bHLH families), and promoter motif analysis identified a proximal GCC-rich element within salt-inducible CAT paralogs corresponding to putative AP2/ERF-binding sites. Together, these findings elucidate the organ-specific division of labor and cis-regulatory landscape underlying halotolerance in P. oleracea, providing prioritized candidate targets for engineering climate-resilient crops.

papers.title: Artificial Cells and Biomimetic Cells: Intelligent Systems Driving a Paradigm Shift in Drug Discovery and Delivery.
papers.abstract: The convergence of synthetic biology, materials science, and artificial intelligence drives a transformative shift in biopharmaceutical research, advancing from passive drug carriers to intelligent, programmable therapeutics. This review evaluates artificial and biomimetic cells as a framework that connects fundamental biological discovery with clinical translation. It examines five key technological pathways: membrane-engineered artificial cells, membraneless organelle (MLO) systems, multicompartmental artificial cells, protocell communication networks, and virtual cells. These platforms enable precise regulation of drug stability, targeting, biosynthesis, and adaptive responsiveness. Recent progress includes microenvironment-triggered release, logic-gated intercellular communication, and virtual cell-assisted high-throughput screening and toxicity prediction. Despite these advances, challenges remain in scalable manufacturing, long-term stability, and regulatory adaptation. The integration of closed-loop learning, interpretable models, and advanced biomanufacturing will be essential to position artificial and biomimetic cell systems at the forefront of next-generation precision medicine.

summary.takeaway: 综述了人工细胞与仿生细胞作为连接基础生物学发现与临床转化的框架，涵盖五种技术路径并强调其作为智能可编程治疗系统的潜力。
summary.methods: 综述性文章，评估了膜工程人工细胞、无膜细胞器（MLO）系统、多区室人工细胞、原细胞通讯网络和虚拟细胞五种技术路径，并总结了微环境触发释放、逻辑门控细胞间通讯以及虚拟细胞辅助的高通量筛选与毒性预测等进展。
summary.relevance: 该综述将虚拟细胞作为五种关键技术路径之一，并提及虚拟细胞辅助的高通量筛选和毒性预测，直接关联给定研究主题“虚拟细胞”。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体研究数据或定量结果，且作为综述，其结论基于对现有文献的归纳；虚拟细胞部分仅简要提及，未深入讨论其技术细节或验证情况。
